text:
Karoline Leavitt previously served as President Donald Trump's White House Press Secretary

While on maternity leave, the temporarily absent White House Press Secretary, Karoline Leavitt, took to social media to share highlights from her latest family trip.

Even though Karoline, 28, isn't working in Washington, D.C. at the moment, the communications expert can't seem to stay far away. On Friday, June 5, Karoline shared photos of herself, her husband, Nicholas, 60, and their children posing in front of the Lincoln Memorial Monument in D.C. on X, formerly known as Twitter. Seen in the background was the new reflecting pool that President Donald Trump, 79, is in the process of having added to the historic landmark.

"We took a family trip to the Lincoln Monument tonight to check out the new reflecting pool. Absolutely stunning. DC is so beautiful again, just in time for our Nation’s 250th. Thank you, President Trump!!" Karoline exclaimed in her caption. It comes as Karoline was slammed for 'flexing' her luxurious gifts while ordinary Americans struggle.

Under her X post, she had many in agreement, as well as several who admitted that they missed seeing her represent Trump as the White House Press Secretary.

"We sure miss you but enjoy your time with your precious family. You look wonderful!" one X user wrote.

"It's really beautiful. You look fantastic and have a beautiful family, Karoline. You're missed at the WH Press Briefings," another added.

Karoline 'thanked' Trump for adding the reflecting pool to the Lincoln Memorial Monument

Someone else questioned, "When might you be back at the podium at the White House? Can't wait for you to be back at the White House!!"

Karoline has been keeping her supporters updated, specifically when it comes to her family. Last Sunday, May 31, she shared an Instagram Story post of her holding her newborn son.

The now mother-of-two captioned the post of her beaming with, "What a beautiful day. I hope everyone is having a great weekend."

That weekend, Trump had flooded his Truth Social account with numerous aggressive AI photos of himself.

The Lincoln Memorial Monument is in Washington D.C.

On Saturday, May 30, alone, the president published over 50 times throughout the course of seven hours, where he shared both messages and images. Also, in a previous statement, he defended Jaxson Dart, 23.

The New York Giants quarterback caught backlash online after attending a Trump rally and introducing the POTUS at the event.

"Thank you Jaxson! It was great being with you," Trump wrote in his statement. "I know you're taking some heat from the Radical Left Lunatics who are jealous of you, me, and everyone who surrounds us but, I also know that your Jersey also went to Number One, and you're making Millions of Dollars so, YOU ARE A WINNER - THEY ARE ALL LOSERS. I'll see you in the White House! President DJT."

Meanwhile, Karoline revealed how much sleep she gets as a working mom in the White House.
